provenance.policy: Explicit opt-in recommendation only. Loading or inspecting this profile does not enforce global kind bindings, import APS validation code, create related objects, change existing source snapshots, or activate execution/admission/authorization policy.

preservation.legacy_alias_migration: No aliases are silently merged here. The original 47 protected representation types and all sealed snapshots remain unchanged; any legacy-to-APS mapping is a separate versioned artifact.

provenance.identity_policy: syn://type/<slug> and synny://type/<slug> are aliases of one type. Native types retain syn:// spellings; these authored records retain their preferred synny:// spellings. Instance source references retain their original native kind and ID.
provenance.abstract_placement_policy: APS abstract flags are copied from the original authored metadata. Abstract native placement entries express only this recommendation profile and do not edit native declarations.
provenance.no_artifact_primitive: The native reference/model kind set contains Type plus nine instance primitives and has no artifact kind. Native artifact is material-thing; Potbot byte/file artifacts use digital/file/representation semantics.

source_evidence_examples.description: The native implementation creates a distinct Event classified observation, an Ember classified observation-result, and another Ember classified network-measurement, connected by EventTarget and ObjectRelationship.

provenance.unimplemented_semantics: The proposed relations and placements require separate checked runtime contracts before enforcement. Native generic JSON fields and direct typeProperties do not implement APS value validation, objective scoring, execution, question resolution, private credential access, or authority transfer.
